description: This file defines an abstract class 'ReportDataAPI' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Api\Rest'. It provides a base implementation for REST API endpoints related to report data retrieval, including methods for fetching all report data (`getAll`) and abstract methods for obtaining report details. The class utilizes various traits and external API components, manages validation rules, and is part of a larger HR management system project.

classes.name: ReportDataAPI
classes.description: An abstract class providing REST API functionality for report data retrieval, including validation and result formatting.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all report data after validating the request and preparing filter parameters. Returns an EndpointCollectionResult containing report data and metadata.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide the specific report object implementing EndpointAwareReport.

methods.name: getReportName
methods.description: Returns the report name parameter from the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns the collection of validation rules for the 'getAll' method, initializing them if needed.

methods.name: getReportNameParamRule
methods.description: Creates a validation rule for the report name parameter.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; creation functionality is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; create validation rules are not supported.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; delete functionality is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; delete validation rules are not supported.
